objective: Make the Cloud IaC GitOps evidence gate fail closed when Argo CD Application templates omit signed-image Helm parameters.

best_practice_sources.what_it_establishes: Argo CD supports Helm parameters in Application source configuration; this ChangeSet validates required local Helm parameters without running Argo CD or Helm.
Argo CD Application manifests model source, destination, sync policy, and Helm source fields; this slice remains local template validation only.
Cosign verification is an explicit command/evidence step; this ChangeSet only preserves the signed-image digest placeholder and does not claim verification execution.
Sigstore policy-controller can enforce image policies at admission time; admission enforcement remains outside this local template gate.
Kubernetes documentation ties verified images to digest-pinned manifests; this ChangeSet keeps a signed-image digest placeholder in GitOps templates without claiming live verification.

red_tests.summary: The GitOps evidence gate accepted a fixture missing the image.digest Helm parameter before the fix.

implemented_claims: The GitOps evidence gate now requires each Application template to include a Helm parameter named image.digest.
The image.digest Helm parameter must preserve the metadata-only {{signed_image_digest}} placeholder.
The GitOps evidence gate now requires each Application template to include a Helm parameter named image.cosign.required.
The image.cosign.required Helm parameter must preserve value true.
The Cloud IaC manifest records these signed-image Helm parameter fields and local-only invariants.
explicit_non_claims: No cosign verification command, image signing, admission-controller enforcement, Argo CD API, Kubernetes API, Helm CLI, or live sync/diff/health/prune/self-heal is implemented.

No deployed endpoint, production auth/Cedar runtime, provider runtime, tofu plan/apply/state, object-store integration, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, production readiness, hyperscaler readiness, or cloud provisioning is claimed.
false_green_findings_closed: The GitOps evidence gate can no longer pass a template that keeps top-level cosign annotations but drops the image.digest Helm parameter required to render a digest-pinned workload image.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not claimed green.
Aggregate ./bin/oya gate run-all is not claimed green unless freshly rerun and proven.
This is a local template text gate only; live cosign/admission/Argo CD/Kubernetes evidence remains future work.

findings: Small fail-closed extension to existing required-line checks; no parser dependency or runtime integration was added.
Hardens the GitOps supply-chain contract before tenant workload rollout by preserving digest and cosign-required render inputs.
RED fixture proved signed-image parameter omission previously passed; GREEN rejects it.
Template authors get deterministic local gate feedback when signed-image render inputs are removed.
Focused tests, live gates, fmt/check/clippy, governance gates, and scoped Cloud IaC suite passed.

alternatives_named: Add a YAML parser and structural Helm param parser
Extend local exact-line GitOps evidence guard now
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: Exact-line validation closes the immediate false-green while keeping the slice local, deterministic, and dependency-free.
rejected_reasons: Live enforcement requires signed images, cluster admission configuration, credentials, and runtime evidence outside this slice.
A parser dependency is unnecessary for the current fixed template contract.

findings: The local gate preserves signed image digest/cosign render inputs and still rejects credential-like template material.
Adds constant-size text checks over five local templates; no runtime path affected.
Improves traceability of signed-image intent; compliance-grade admission/signature evidence remains non-claimed.
Live templates already contained these parameters, so the gate hardens existing contract without changing rendered template shape.
Bad template edits fail before later sync/deploy work can depend on missing image digest inputs.
ChangeSet is tied to Oya VCS claim, tests, manifest/tasks, evidence, and audit-chain rows.
Used Oya VCS claim, avoided raw git/gh, kept /plan complementary-only, and did not claim production/hyperscaler completion.
No new dependencies were introduced; strict dependency-seam is run at closeout.

review_findings: No critical/high issue found for local gate scope. Live signing/admission verification remains explicitly non-claimed.
